text: On the Plan page, Save and Swap now say they apply to every future workout of that day, and that past workouts and history stay as they are.
You can now change the sets and reps of your plan's exercises, swap one for another, or reset the whole plan to the recommended one from Home.
The open and close arrow on workout and history rows is now a proper chevron, and the Sessions number on Progress is slightly larger.
During a workout the bottom bar no longer lights up Home, since no tab is the page you are on.
Finish Workout no longer reports an error right after an app update when the workout was in fact saved.
Tapping Log Set twice, or retrying after a bad connection, now logs the set once, and a screen reader announces each set you log.
The exercise form-cues sheet now has a Done button at the bottom you can reach with your thumb, keyboard focus stays inside the sheet, and the sets and reps labels sit above their numbers.
If you sign out while offline, the app now finishes signing you out on the server as soon as it can reach it again.
Typing a number into weight or reps no longer leaves a leading zero in front of it.
Weight and reps you enter right after opening a workout are no longer replaced by the suggested values.
Tap the version number to see what changed in recent updates.
